name: const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> Pin < Ptr >
rule: Unless Ptr::Target implements Unpin, the caller must ensure that it is not possible to obtain a mutable reference to the pointee and then move the pointee out through that reference.
api: impl < Ptr : Deref > core::pin::Pin < Ptr > { const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> core::pin::Pin < Ptr > }
